description: Returns counts of sent, delivered, bounced, complained, received and reply messages per day or per hour (UTC), for the workspace or one agent. Without a range: the last 30 days by day, or the last 48 hours by hour.

agent_id.description: Filter by agent id or name. A key tied to one agent always reads that agent's mail, and naming another agent is a 403.

from.description: Start of the range (ISO 8601, or YYYY-MM-DD).

to.description: End of the range, exclusive (ISO 8601, or YYYY-MM-DD).

name: mails_metrics_get
title: Get mail metrics
